note: Art origins, best first. The client prefixes the art manifests' image/Spine URLs with the first source that clears its throughput bar (/asset-mirrors.json is its probe) and falls back to the game server — see docs/ASSETS.md. `http://103.205.254.40` is the owner's own relay (宿迁云 Debian 12, nginx over a clone of this repository's public/; moved off the old Aliyun Beijing box on 2026-10-26) and is listed in `fullSources` because it ALSO reimplements the game's extension-less routes (/media audio, /scene battlefield bundles, /clip boot video): with it installed the client sends those classes to the relay too. The plain-file mirrors below serve files only (no /media, /scene or /clip) and are used for images. Measured from Zhejiang Mobile on 2026-10-18 on a 12 MB file: cdn.jsdmirror.com ~2.0 MB/s and jsdelivr.b-cdn.net ~2.1 MB/s both completed it, while raw.githubusercontent.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net and gcore.jsdelivr.net timed out and gh-proxy.com managed ~0.1 MB/s — hence the mainland-friendly jsDelivr mirrors first (cdn.bring.cool was measured at ~0.5 MB/s on 2026-10-18 and is a different CDN from jsdmirror, so it backs it up), no canonical CDN, gh-proxy as the last plain-file tier. jsDelivr reflections share one GitHub backend, so a 403 from them is a transient on-demand fetch limit, not a missing file. Update the owner/repo in the CDN entries if the repository moves. Traffic on the relay is unmetered (owner, 2026-10-14).
